title: In Range?
prompt: age is given. Print working age if 18 <= age < 65 — with one chained comparison.

tests.name: uses chained comparison
tests.code:
assert printed == ["working age"], f"got {printed}"
assert " and " not in code, "use 18 <= age < 65 chaining"
tests.hint: if 18 <= age < 65: reads exactly like the requirement.
